import networkx as nx

G = nx.complete_bipartite_graph(7, 8)
print("Nodes:", G.number_of_nodes())
print("Edges:", G.number_of_edges())
print("Max clique:", nx.graph_clique_number(G))
print("Chromatic number:", 2) # bipartite
print("Min degree:", min(dict(G.degree()).values()))

edges = list(G.edges())
flattened = []
for u, v in edges:
    flattened.extend([u, v])
print(flattened)
